notes.title: 🚨 Release 0.58.0 is LIVE! 🚨
notes.notes: [p]Hey GOALS community,[/p][p]0.58.0 brings a big focus on animation and smoother gameplay. From a new goalkeeper saving system to smarter AI and refined player movement, the pitch feel more dynamic and natural. You’ll also notice improvements to set pieces, tackling, and even the camera options. Here are some of the highlights:[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Highlights[/b]:[/h2][list][*][p]New [b]goalkeeper saving system[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]stepover skill move[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Less aggressive lock-on[/b] for more natural control [/p][/*][*][p][b]Movement updates:[/b] refined acceleration, smoother dribbling, pre-trap movement, and jockey nerfs [/p][/*][*][p][b]Curve-based motion system[/b] for more natural stumbles, get-ups, and penalty run-ups[/p][/*][*][p][b]Blocking & tackling improvements[/b] including fixes, balance tweaks, and bone collision detection[/p][/*][*][p][b]Set piece upgrades[/b] with better free kick positioning and new wall behaviours[/p][/*][*][p][b]Smarter AI [/b]with improved movement, attacking/defensive logic, and signal animations[/p][/*][*][p][b]Updated camera option [/b]with adjusted height and zoom[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]New stepover skill move: [/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920323/f317a3490aaee8d5b0be794d7432931af9d6d222.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Full patch notes details on our [url="http://playgoals.com/en/news/patch-notes-0-58-0?utm_source=goals.beehiiv.com&utm_medium=newsletter&utm_campaign=new-team-tactics-system-with-patch-0-56-3"]website[/url].   (Coming soon)[/p][p][/p][p]Jump in, test it out, and [url="http://discord.gg/goals?utm_source=goals.beehiiv.com&utm_medium=newsletter&utm_campaign=new-team-tactics-system-with-patch-0-56-3"][i]let us know how it feels[/i][/url]. We’re building this together, see you on the pitch![/p]

notes.title: 🚨 Release 0.57.0 is LIVE! 🚨
notes.notes: [p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/yTbuolJ.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This one’s for the tacticians! [/p][p]0.57.0 introduces new formations and the first iteration of player roles, with unique mentalities that shape how your team behaves on the pitch. [/p][p]There’s also been a lot of work under the hood: smarter AI, tighter controls, cleaner animations. The kind of stuff you feel more than see. [/p][p]Check out the latest on Alpha. [/p][p]Build GOALS with us.[/p][p][/p][h2]Highlights:[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]Improved through passes, lofted pass/cross trajectories, and pass selection. [/p][/*][*][p]Tuned movement, shooting, ball speed and skill moves. [/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked second player press, call player short, interceptions, and open goal aim assist. [/p][/*][*][p]Reworked blocking with new movement and animations. [/p][/*][*][p]Faster stumbles, and tweaked shoulder barge.[/p][/*][*][p]Offensive and defensive AI is now more coordinated and positionally aware. [/p][/*][*][p]Player roles added, with a set of special mentalities. [/p][/*][*][p]Three new formations added. [/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked gameplay cameras. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Player Roles: [/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/70BOMWR.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Full list of patch notes can be found on our [url="https://playgoals.com/en/news/patch-notes-0-57-0"]website[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Jump in, test it out, and [i]let us know how it feels[/i]. See you on the pitch![/p]

notes.title: 🚨 Release 0.55.0 is LIVE! 🚨
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/T6g7KdP.png[/img]

Patch 0.55.0 is here!

Featuring:
[list]
[*] New stamina system 
[*] Removal of physical tackles in favour of contextual shoulder barge 
[*] Improved interception logic and fewer accidental tackle triggers
[*] Lowered ground pass speed and capped trap heights for better control 
[*] Sprint dribble turns buffed, speed up now distance-based 
[*] Offensive and defensive AI upgrades for better runs and positioning 
[*] Traditional corner system added or more immersion and to follow standard rules
[*] Upgraded GK animations and movement
[*] New Ranked! 
[/list]

You can see the full list of easy-to-read patch notes on our website[url=https://playgoals.com/en/news/patch-notes-0-55-0] here[/url]!

notes.title: 🚨 Release 0.40.0 is LIVE! 🚨
notes.notes:
Hey GOALS community,

We’re excited to announce that Patch 0.40.0 is now live, bringing a host of new features and improvements to elevate your gameplay! With smarter AI, new animations, and enhanced visual effects, every match feels more immersive and strategic. From slide tackles and preferred foot logic to fully implemented goalkeepers, this update adds more depth and excitement to the pitch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022388/b0da3d7fc39024d04ef4d9ee5b584b62db41519e.png[/img]
